principles: Keep the work documentation-only and do not implement future CLI commands in this story.
Use Lattice hard gates and structured host_verdict evidence rather than prose-only review claims.
Preserve scope, evidence freshness, and Authority boundary semantics in the execution plan.
drivers: The user asked for real 3 round 2 host validation of the document.
The document changes a decision-doc path and therefore should exercise the decision-doc quorum gate.
The plan will guide future implementation of durable decision-doc promotion.

options.name: A: Dedicated documentation audit story with 3x2 quorum
pros: Lets Lattice gates consume the actual changed decision doc
Provides structured evidence for the user question
cons: Adds lifecycle overhead for a document-only change

options.name: B: Single-host audit on main
cons: Does not answer the user 3x2 question
Would bypass the decision-doc quorum mechanism

options.name: C: Implement decision_doc_proposal now
pros: Would directly build the future capability
cons: Expands scope beyond the current request
Raises higher implementation and regression risk

chosen: A: Dedicated documentation audit story with 3x2 quorum
rationale: Choose a dedicated documentation audit story because the user specifically asked for Lattice 3 round 2 host validation, while implementation of future commands is explicitly out of scope.

preMortem.scenario: The audit story silently expands into implementing decision_doc_proposal or decision_doc_save.
preMortem.trigger: Reviewer or agent treats the execution plan as authorization to code the commands now.
preMortem.consequence: Scope expansion contaminates a document audit and risks unrelated CLI behavior changes.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep scope boundary and checklist limited to docs plus quorum evidence; any implementation becomes a separate story.

preMortem.scenario: The document is reviewed by prose only and still lacks real 3x2 host_verdict evidence.
preMortem.trigger: Reviewers write pass notes but no structured host_verdict rounds are recorded.
preMortem.consequence: The user question remains unanswered and DONE gate should block the changed decision doc.
preMortem.mitigation: Record three distinct autopilot_review_submit rounds with two distinct hosts each and verify decision_doc_quorum_check.

preMortem.scenario: The document overclaims local quorum as Authority or production completion.
preMortem.trigger: Wording around host verdicts uses Authority or productionDone language loosely.
preMortem.consequence: Future implementers may confuse local workflow evidence with receipt-backed Authority completion.
preMortem.mitigation: Review and grep for Authority boundary language; require explicit no productionDone/no Authority receipt completion wording.
